The member writes the exact ruleset JSON for refs/heads/release/** (creation/deletion restricted to the owner, pull request required, squash only, the same required status contexts as develop-squash-only, no force push) into docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md and this item's context; the owner applies it before the final PR merges; the drift check expects it. description: Owner decision 2026-11-06: shipping a fix on an older release without shipping everything on develop is a requirement (for example a security fix as 0.5.1 after 0.6.0). Neither the old nor the current flow supports it: release-v2 admits only a dist from a develop trunk run (scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py:27,179,196,411,653; trunk.yml:8-10). Implement on-demand maintenance lines: the owner creates `release/X.Y.x` from the `vX.Y.0` (or latest vX.Y.Z) tag commit; fixes land by PR into that branch with the same CI and oracle review as develop; trunk.yml runs on pushes to `release/**` and builds the dist; admission accepts a tag whose commit is on exactly one protected line (develop or the release/X.Y.x branch matching the tag's X.Y) with a successful trunk push run on that exact commit; the release UAT check falls back to full UAT when no trunk UAT evidence exists for the line; the GitHub release for a maintenance tag is created with `--latest=false`; the release's changelog section is also added to develop. Files: .github/workflows/trunk.yml, ci.yml:118-137 (accept release/* bases), review-gate.yml:44 (gated base per branch; check whether Theseus needs an upstream input), release_artifact_consumer.py, release-v2.yml github-release step, scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py and docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md (expected `release-branches` ruleset for refs/heads/release/**), changelog/version tests that assume one branch, the benchbox release skill and docs/internal/release-guide.md (maintenance-release procedure). Rollback: revert this member's commits; the owner deletes the ruleset.
